findings.designContract: docs/design/DESIGN.md:1-91 (HIG remake contract, 2026-11-11). Read as the BEFORE, not as a lock: the owner asked for the skin to be replaced (brief 2026-11-14). Note: the brief names apps/web/DESIGN.md; the file is docs/design/DESIGN.md.
findings.fonts: Pretendard Variable 45-920, bundled TTF (apps/web/public/fonts/pretendard/PretendardVariable.ttf; @font-face apps/web/src/styles/foundation.css:5-11) as UI, reading and display face (foundation.css:15). Achmage SameTone (the owner's own OFL face, bundled woff2, @font-face styles.css:8-29) is declared but overridden by foundation.css:15 (--font-read/--font-display -> Pretendard); it survives only as a per-look option. Mono: JetBrains Mono -> D2Coding -> ui-monospace (styles.css:44), not bundled.
findings.palette: hex/rgb custom properties, defined twice: styles.css:96-120 (older '괘선 노트' look) and foundation.css:13-97 (HIG remake, wins by import order main.tsx:9-10). Light: paper #fff, chrome #f3f5f8, ink #151b27, muted #566173, line #dce1e8, accent #005bac, brand teal #00a8a3, navy heading #00102e, engine Claude #c96442. Dark: paper #131820, chrome #10151c, accent #7db2f0. 335 hex literals (169 distinct) and 64 rgb() literals across 61 stylesheets.
findings.spacing: three scales side by side: --space-1..10 (styles.css:56-66, 4px base; 505 uses), HIG kit --s-1..12 (vendor/hig-kit/kit.css:49; 215 uses), and raw px (padding 293 distinct values, gap 51).
findings.radii: --r-* defined twice with different values: styles.css:69-75 (4/6/8/12/16) and foundation.css:19 (4/8/12/18/26, wins). 41 distinct border-radius values in use.
findings.motion: no motion library. Tokens defined three times: styles.css:79-85 (--dur-press 90 / fast 140 / base 200 / slow 280), foundation.css:20 (120/120/220/320, wins), kit.css:57 (--dur-1/2/3 120/220/320, --ease). styles/motion.css:1-60. 46 distinct transition declarations; 34 prefers-reduced-motion blocks; 43 @keyframes.
findings.icons: Lucide paths vendored into components/Icon.tsx:1-222 (64 glyphs, 24 viewBox, stroke 1.75, default 16px); engine marks in EngineMark.tsx; Hangul office ribbon icons inside the office iframe are a second set.
findings.brand: Achmage wordmark + Arc/Rune symbol (apps/web/src/brand/achmage-wordmark.json, components/BrandMark.tsx:2-5, from the owner's own site); named brand tokens --brand-ink #00102e and --brand-accent #00a8a3 (foundation.css:52, :64); Achmage blue #005bac (foundation.css:23); the owner's face Achmage SameTone (styles.css:7). DESIGN.md:13-15 names blue/teal/navy as the brand roles.
findings.framework: React 19.3 + Vite 8 (apps/web/package.json:30-52), Tauri 2 shell (apps/desktop; WebKitGTK on Linux, WebView2, WKWebView). No Tailwind, no CSS modules: 61 global stylesheets (17,840 lines; styles.css alone 5,916), imported in order main.tsx:8-16 then per component. A vendored HIG kit (vendor/hig-kit/kit.css, 925 lines, hk-* classes) sits beside the app's own control classes.
findings.product: runs: scripts/design-shots.ts boots the bundled host (apps/host/dist/host.mjs) with stand-in engines and a seeded fixture; --serve keeps it up. Captured in Playwright Chromium (fine pointer). The Rust search worker is not built in this worktree, so search shows its error state.
findings.previousHallmark: a Hallmark POLISH ran 2026-11-10 (old .hallmark/preflight.json, stamp foundation.css:1-4): polish depth cannot change composition, which is the owner's complaint.
